_doc: Edit decisions for the three pre-workshop overview videos. See OVERVIEW-VIDEO-PLAN.md. Built by scripts/overview_video.py. All times are SOURCE seconds in the one take. Insert 'cue' is a phrase in the ASR word stream (ASR spelling, no spaces), searched forward from the previous insert; the insert starts on the phrase. src forms: have:<repo path> | make:<name> | shoot:<S#> | source:<src-id> | pair:[src, src]. 'hook' is the cold open: quick shots, each {in, out, show} with show 'talk' (speaker at the edit's zoom there, or 'level') or an insert id; hard-cut, then a fade to black, then the cover as a banner fading in and out with the intro music (<work_dir>/music/intro.*).
